name: Refuel for the Zapping
label: Quest
description: Zorbin Fandazzle needs more water elemental cores. Setting up shop on the Forgotten Coast is a struggle, so the pay will be smaller, but Zorbin promises…
intro: Zorbin Fandazzle needs more water elemental cores. Setting up shop on the Forgotten Coast is a struggle, so the pay will be smaller, but Zorbin promises to tell everyone in earshot of your help and says there are friends in the Cartel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: More work, you say? Did my heroic mission of collecting bits of goo found inside elemental beings not slake your thirst for adventure? Perhaps more of the same will vainly try to fill the bottomless well of questing you possess...

OK, melodrama aside, I do need more water elemental cores. I'm trying desperately to set up shop here, so the rewards won't be as great... But I promise you I'll tell everyone in earshot how you've helped me. Trust me on this - I know people in the Cartel!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you managed to find the elemental cores I need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Top notch, friend, top notch! While the coin I give you might not be the most you'll ever receive for such work, rest assured my comrades in the Steamwheedle Cartel will hear about your efforts!
If you are looking for anything else to do, then let me know. I can always use more elemental cores and such.
